plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-03 — quoted Excel TSV clipboard import

regression.root_cause: Plain-text TSV clipboard import split each line on literal tabs. Quoted cells containing tabs or line breaks were corrupted, doubled quotes were not decoded, and terminal CRLF could create an unintended empty record.
regression.before_fix: The targeted core regression failed: quoted delimiters and embedded newlines were split into separate cells/rows.
regression.implementation: Reuse dependency-free core/table-tsv.js parseTableTsv for plain-text TSV. Normalize CRLF, remove only one terminal clipboard row terminator, preserve additional blank records, pad ragged rows, keep the 100-row/24-column limits, and invalidate the cached richtext-import module URL.
cases: quoted CRLF inside cell normalized to LF
one terminal CRLF ignored while an additional blank record is preserved
